historicalCaution: The 1969 GT-R is the PGC10 four-door sedan; the KPGC10 two-door hardtop followed in 1970. Model year, depicted specification and photograph capture date are separate. This collection combines period photographs with modern photographs of historic cars and replicas; each caption identifies the distinction.

historySources.supports: R32 GT-R launched August 1989, after the R32 Skyline launch in May 1989
R35 GT-R announced October 24, 2007; Japan availability from December 6, 2007
1999 Pennzoil Nismo GT-R and its JGTC championship
2015 GT-R Nismo GT3 Bathurst 12 Hour win; the photograph itself is dated 7 February
